name: Jill Christophe
source:
A brilliant royal aide and spokesperson who also serves as your educator.
He puts the protection of the country first and foremost.
He is often consulted by the people of the castle, and he responds sincerely each time.

[Taken from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/100puri/chara/100jill_christophe.html]official website[/url]]
